# Simulate data

Dates

```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(3111963)
# define N
n=1e6
# define start and end of registry
start_date=as.Date("2005-01-01")
end_date=as.Date("2022-12-31")
max_days=as.numeric(end_date - start_date)
# simulate dates
backward_days=rtruncexp(n=n,
                        rate=0.0002,
                        max=max_days)
# calculate onset date
onsetdatev=end_date-floor(backward_days)
```

Covariates

```{r}
set.seed(22101957)
df=data.frame(id=1:n,ageonset=runif(n,0.5,6),
              event=1,
              u=runif(n,0,1),
              e=rnorm(n,0.5,0.02),
              sex=sample(c('male','female'),n,replace=T))
# mutate
df=df %>% 
  mutate(onsetdate=onsetdatev,
         calendar=year(onsetdate),
         calendar_c=calendar-mean(year(onsetdatev)),
         trialdate=as.Date('2021-05-31'))
# set mortality and landmark
pzero=0.5
tau=2*365.25
```

# Tune

## Build filtere dataset

```{r}
prep = function(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex){
  df %>% 
    mutate(post = onsetdate >= trialdate,
           ptrt = plogis(t_int - t_age*ageonset + t_sex*(sex=="male")),
           conf = u < ptrt,
           trt  = as.integer(conf & post)) %>% 
    filter(!(post & !conf))   # drop untreated patients with onset after the trial date
}

get_smds = function(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex){
  d = prep(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex)
  c(smd::smd(d$ageonset, d$trt)$estimate,
    smd::smd(d$sex, d$trt)$estimate)
}
```

## Solve for the treatment parameters to get SMDs

```{r}
solve_treatment = function(df, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, t_int = 1, start = c(0.75, 2)){
  obj = function(par){
    sum((get_smds(df, t_int, par[1], par[2]) - c(target_smd_age, target_smd_sex))^2)
  }
  o = optim(start, obj, method = "Nelder-Mead", control = list(reltol = 1e-10))
  c(t_age = o$par[1], t_sex = o$par[2])
}
```

## Solve for outcome parameters to get bias

```{r}
bias_fun = function(d, b_age, b_sex, t = 730){
  lpcov  = -b_age*d$ageonset + b_sex*(d$sex=="male") - 0.01*d$calendar_c + d$e
  lambda = uniroot(function(l) mean(1 - exp(-l*exp(lpcov)*tau/30)) - pzero,
                   interval = c(0, 1e15), tol = 1e-12)$root
  risk = 1 - exp(-lambda*exp(lpcov)*t/30)
  mean(risk[d$trt == 1]) / mean(risk[d$trt == 0]) - 1   # naive RR / true RR - 1
}

solve_outcome = function(d, target_bias, ratio = 0.5/0.75){
  b_age = uniroot(function(b) bias_fun(d, b, ratio*b) - target_bias,
                  interval = c(0.01, 2), tol = 1e-6)$root
  c(b_age = b_age, b_sex = ratio*b_age)
}
```

## Get values given targets

```{r}
calibrate_dgm = function(df, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, target_bias,
                         t_int = 1, ratio = 0.5/0.75){
  trt_par = solve_treatment(df, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, t_int)
  d       = prep(df, t_int, trt_par["t_age"], trt_par["t_sex"])
  out_par = solve_outcome(d, target_bias, ratio)

  # check: recompute the achieved values with the solved parameters
  achieved = c(get_smds(df, t_int, trt_par["t_age"], trt_par["t_sex"]),
               bias_fun(d, out_par["b_age"], out_par["b_sex"]))
  names(achieved) = c("smd_age", "smd_sex", "rel_bias")

  list(parameters = c(t_int = t_int, trt_par, out_par), achieved = achieved)
}

calibrate_dgm(df, target_smd_age = 0.5, target_smd_sex = 0.5, target_bias = 0.20)
```
